So Joab and the people who were with him came near to the front of the Syrians to the battle; and they fled before him.
When the children of Ammon saw that the Syrians had fled, they likewise fled before Abishai his brother, and entered…

people.name: Joab
people.line: Son of Zeruiah, commander of David's army

people.name: Syria

translations.web: So Joab and the people who were with him came near to the battle against the Syrians, and they fled before him.
translations.bsb: So Joab and his troops advanced to fight the Arameans, who fled before him.
translations.kjv: And Joab drew nigh, and the people that were with him, unto the battle against the Syrians: and they fled before him.
translations.asv: So Joab and the people that were with him drew nigh unto the battle against the Syrians: and they fled before him.
